rounds.prompt: The festival offers an impressive range of workshops. ___ Even so, booking early is advisable.

options.text: The town has two bridges.
The river runs behind the station.
The most popular sessions fill up quickly.

rounds.explanation: The first option creates the problem that makes the advice logical.

rounds.prompt: The novel uses short chapters and a straightforward narrative. ___ Readers can easily return to it during a busy week.

options.text: This structure makes the book convenient to read in brief sessions.
The book was published in May.
The cover includes a photograph.

rounds.explanation: The first option explains why the structure helps busy readers.

rounds.prompt: This review considers whether the new software is useful for small businesses. ___ The examples focus on budgets, invoices and customer records.

options.text: It is aimed at readers who manage everyday business tasks.
The software was installed on Tuesday.
The office has a glass door.

rounds.explanation: The first option makes the intended reader clear before the examples.

rounds.prompt: The restaurant offers excellent ingredients and attentive service, but prices are high. ___ Taking everything into account, it is better for special occasions.

options.text: The chef arrived before lunch.
The restaurant has a long name.
The quality is impressive enough to make the cost understandable for some diners.

rounds.explanation: The sentence balances high price with quality before the final judgement.

rounds.prompt: The museum provides step-free entrances and clear audio descriptions. ___ It should therefore suit visitors with different access needs.

options.text: The museum shop sells postcards.
The building was painted last year.
These features allow more people to enjoy the collection independently.

rounds.explanation: The first option explains the effect of the access features.

rounds.prompt: The book has a slow opening but develops a thoughtful argument about responsibility. ___ For this reason, it rewards readers who are willing to continue.

options.text: The cover uses a dark colour.
Its later chapters connect the personal story with a wider social question.
The book has a contents page.

rounds.explanation: The wider social question explains why patience is rewarded.

rounds.prompt: The theatre is small, but every seat is close to the stage. ___ This creates an unusually intimate atmosphere.

options.text: The theatre sells postcards outside.
The audience can see the actors' expressions clearly.
The street has a post office.

rounds.explanation: Seeing expressions clearly explains the positive effect of the small space.

rounds.prompt: The centre offers interactive displays and a short guided tour. ___ For this reason, it is particularly suitable for families with children.

options.text: The guide arrived by bicycle.
Both activities encourage children to take part rather than only watch.
The ticket has a barcode.

rounds.explanation: The sentence explains why the activities fit the family audience.

rounds.prompt: The exhibition is specialist, but the introductory tour explains its main ideas. ___ Nevertheless, beginners can still enjoy the visit.

options.text: The guide also defines unfamiliar terms before each room.
The building has a high roof.
The tickets are numbered.

rounds.explanation: Defining unfamiliar terms explains why beginners can follow the tour.

rounds.prompt: The special effects are technically impressive. ___ However, the characters receive less attention than the visuals.

options.text: The final storm scene creates a convincing sense of danger.
The director was born abroad.
The tickets are printed at the entrance.

rounds.explanation: The storm scene gives concrete evidence for the technical evaluation.

rounds.prompt: The exhibition opens next Saturday and brings together five local photographers. ___ Visitors can also hear short interviews with the artists.

options.text: The café closes before lunch.
The swimming pool is outdoors.
It focuses on ordinary experiences in the city.

rounds.explanation: The first option develops the exhibition topic before adding another feature.

rounds.prompt: The book combines a clear style with thoughtful questions about responsibility. ___ It is an engaging choice for readers who enjoy reflective fiction.

options.text: The first page has a date.
The short chapters also make it easy to read in stages.
The cover is mostly blue.

rounds.explanation: The sentence adds a practical benefit before the final recommendation.

rounds.prompt: The production combines live music with a modern interpretation of the play. ___ It is likely to appeal to audiences who enjoy experimental theatre.

options.text: The changes give the familiar story an energetic and unexpected quality.
The programme is printed weekly.
The theatre has a small ticket office.

rounds.explanation: The sentence explains why the creative choices suit that audience.

rounds.prompt: The novel explores responsibility through quiet dialogue and implied emotion. ___ As a result, it rewards readers who prefer subtle stories.

options.text: The characters rarely state their feelings directly.
The story has twelve chapters.
The paperback has a wide cover.

rounds.explanation: The indirect emotions support the description of the story as subtle.

rounds.prompt: The experience offers genuine value despite minor limitations. ___ Taking everything into account, it is worth recommending to visitors with realistic expectations.

options.text: The visitor bought a ticket online.
The venue has a long corridor.
Its strongest features clearly outweigh the small amount of inconvenience.

rounds.explanation: The first option explains why the final recommendation remains positive.

rounds.prompt: The venue has step-free access, clear signs and staff who answer questions patiently. ___ For these reasons, it is a strong choice for first-time visitors.

options.text: These features make the experience welcoming and easy to navigate.
The ticket office is beside the door.
The venue's roof was repaired recently.

rounds.explanation: The sentence interprets the details before the recommendation.
